answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The relic of work and the sable of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a nectar to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
